versions.changelog:
Initial release of core pathophysiology skills based on PMPH 10th Edition:

- Features 145 core pathophysiology skills, covering major pathophysiology topics (e.g., acid-base balance, shock, inflammation, cell signaling, tumorigenesis).
- Systematically organized categories for teaching, clinical reference, and curriculum integration.
- Each skill includes structured markdown content, easily accessible by directory name.
- Bilingual description (Chinese/English) for broader accessibility.
- MIT licensed for open use and collaboration.
